stories.title: Enforce per-API-key rate limits
stories.description: As a API client, I want per-API-key rate limits enforced, so that my application handles throttling gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Public endpoints return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when rate limit exceeded
Rate limits are configurable per API key via admin endpoint without service restart
stories.source_reference: All public endpoints must enforce per-API-key rate limits

stories.title: Revoke API keys instantly
stories.description: As an API administrator, I want instant key revocation, so that compromised keys are neutralized across all gateway instances.
acceptance_criteria: Key revocation takes effect within 5 seconds across all gateway instances
Admin console supports key rotation with 24-hour grace period on old key
stories.source_reference: Keys must be revocable instantly — revocation must take effect within 5 seconds across all gateway instances

stories.title: Log all inbound requests with redaction
stories.description: As a security analyst, I want all inbound requests logged with sensitive fields redacted, so that I can audit without exposing secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Logs include timestamp, key ID, endpoint, HTTP method, response status, and latency in milliseconds
Sensitive fields (request body, auth header) are redacted before logging
stories.source_reference: All inbound requests must be logged: timestamp, key ID (not the raw key), endpoint, HTTP method, response status, latency in milliseconds

stories.title: Provide /health endpoint for service status
stories.description: As a DevOps engineer, I want a /health endpoint reporting service status and version, so that I can monitor system health.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint returns HTTP 200 with JSON body indicating service status and current version
Endpoint is exempt from authentication and rate limiting
stories.source_reference: A /health endpoint must return HTTP 200 with a JSON body indicating service status and current version

stories.title: Return consistent error JSON envelope
stories.description: As a developer debugging an error, I want consistent error responses with request_id, so that I can trace issues server-side.
acceptance_criteria: All 4xx and 5xx responses follow JSON envelope with error code, message, and request_id
request_id is logged server-side and returned to client for support tracing
stories.source_reference: All 4xx and 5xx responses must follow a consistent JSON envelope

summary: The API Gateway specification outlines public REST API v1 requirements gathered from the architect review on 8 October 2024. Key areas include rate limiting, authentication, request logging, health monitoring, and consistent error handling. The focus is on security, observability, and developer experience.
